hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; git remote get-url upstream >/dev/null 2>&1 || git remote add upstream https://github.com/microsoft/PyRIT.git; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do git fetch upstream --quiet 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 2; done; if [ "$(git branch --show-current)" = main ] && [ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ]; then git merge --no-edit upstream/main >/dev/null 2>&1 || { git merge --abort 2>/dev/null; echo "upstream merge has conflicts: resolve manually"; }; fi; true
